questions.q_en: The side ST and TR and the median SU of the STR are equal to the sides MN, NJ and the median MV of the MNJ Respectively. If TSU = 46°, NMJ = 79°, MVN = 88°, what is the degree measure of 7/11 \(\angle\)SRT?
questions.q_hi: STR की भुजा ST और TR तथा माध्यिका SU क्रमशः MNJ की भुजाओं MN, NJ तथा माध्यिका MV के बराबर हैं। यदि TSU = 46°, NMJ = 79°, MVN = 88° है, तो 7/11 \(\angle\)SRT का डिग्री माप क्या है?
options_en:
35°

    55°

    47°    

    56°
options_hi:
35°

55°

47°

56°
questions.solution_en:
∆STU ≅ ∆MNJ, therefore, SUT= MVN = 88°
And STU = MNV = 180° - [88° + 46°] = 46°

Therefore, SRT= MJN = 180° [79° + 46°] = 55°

7/11\(\angle\) =7/1155° = 35°
questions.solution_hi:
